text:
Completed spec/contract/ with two pages: applications-new for submitting a permit application and fees-quote for calculating a fee. The applicant persona signs in through sandbox-idp with a synthetic username; anonymous-visitor has no sign-in at all. The seed inserts one synthetic applicant user with a matching manifest handle.

I could not recover an OpenAPI description because this project has no sources.old configured.

files.spec/contract/surface.yaml:
# Pages, and the actions and observations each offers. Test IDs are filled at the design gate.
pages:
  - id: applications-new
    domain: applications
    route: /applications
    title: "New permit application"
    actions: { submit: { test_id: null } }
    observations: { status: { test_id: null } }
  - id: fees-quote
    domain: fees
    route: /fees/quote
    title: "Fee quote"
    actions: { calculate: { test_id: null } }
    observations: { amount: { test_id: null } }
files.spec/contract/personas.yaml:
# Roles a test can act as, and how a test signs in as each on every target.
personas:
  - id: applicant
    can: [submit a permit application, view a fee quote]
    sign_in: { sandbox-idp: { username: applicant-1 } }
  - id: anonymous-visitor
    can: [view a fee quote]
    sign_in: null
files.spec/contract/observables.yaml:
# Side effects a test may observe, and how.
email: { via: mail-catcher, api: "${SDLC_MAIL_API}" }
